title: 第8216章 佩戴面具第8215章 谈条件
content_zh:
高飞再次保证，让陆安看向他。
“为什么找我？”陆安说道，“而且这么做对你有什么好处？”
陆安自然不是傻子，高飞这么迫切想要自己去当黑手，还要给自己好处，完全不合乎常理，一定是有特殊的理由。
陆安没问，是对方还没有说出让他心动的好处。既然对方肯拿出强大的法器，他也就没有再拒绝。
高飞深吸气，他知道任谁都会觉得这件事蹊跷，说道，“没什么，就是我需要一些胜利，一些我没办法参与的决斗的胜利。”
无法参与的决斗？
“限制境界？限制年龄？”陆安问。
“对。”高飞说道，“我是做生意的，只要你能赢，我一定会给你非常多好处。不过……前提是你能赢。如果你赢不了的话，你对我毫无意义，刚刚我说的所有好处全部作废。”
陆安的表情十分平静，说道，“我不知道我能不能赢，毕竟我从来没有与相元境厮杀过。”
“这很简单。”高飞说道，“我们达成交易之前，你要先参与一场决斗。让我在决斗场中看到你的实力，只要让我满意，让我感受到你足够强，我们就立刻合作。”
验证？
陆安并不拒绝，略微思索道，“可以。”
见陆安如此痛快答应，高飞眼睛一亮！毕竟这可是去决斗场中厮杀，对方能有胆量真的前往，至少勇气这一关是过了！
“好！”高飞大声道，“你放心，我保证这第一场你肯定不会死。”
说着，高飞改变空间，进入其中。
陆安看着还在瀚宇中的空间坐标，没有犹豫，飞了进去。
——————
——————
瀚宇。
黑星河之一，繁月星河。

某个巨大的星辰上，空间波动，两道身影先后走出。
高飞在前，陆安在后。
刚来到这里，陆安就看向四面八方。
昏暗，压抑。
整个城市之中，充满肃杀和戾气。
负面情绪笼罩整个城市，十分压抑。
陆安看向天空，万里无云，瀚宇的光芒很弱，所以星辰才如此昏暗。
并且，他能够看到一个发光的星辰。
陆安立刻意识到，这个星河的结构可能与仙星河类似，也就是分为宗星和环星，甚至可能存在星系和星流。
不仅如此，陆安还看到瀚宇中有特殊的陆地。
没错。
content_en:
Gao Fei reassured and asked Lu An to look at him.
"Why are you looking for me?" Lu An said, "And what good will this do to you?"
Lu An is certainly not a fool. Gao Fei is so eager to become the mastermind himself and to give himself benefits. This is completely unreasonable. There must be a special reason.
Lu An didn't ask because the other party hadn't yet told him the benefits that made him excited. Since the other party was willing to take out a powerful magic weapon, he didn't refuse anymore.
Gao Fei took a deep breath, knowing that anyone would find this strange, and said, "It's nothing, it's just that I need some victory, some victory in a duel that I can't participate in."
A duel that you can't participate in?
"Restrict the realm? Restrict the age?" Lu An asked.
"Yes." Gao Fei said, "I am in business. As long as you can win, I will definitely give you a lot of benefits. But... the premise is that you can win. If you can't win, you are meaningless to me, and all the benefits I just mentioned will be invalid."
Lu An's expression was very calm and he said, "I don't know if I can win. After all, I have never fought against the Xiangyuan realm."
"It's very simple." Gao Fei said, "Before we make a deal, you have to participate in a duel first. Let me see your strength in the duel field. As long as you satisfy me and let me feel that you are strong enough, we will cooperate immediately."
Verify?
Lu An did not refuse, and thought for a moment and said, "Okay."
Seeing Lu An agree so readily, Gao Fei's eyes lit up! After all, this is a fight in a duel. If the other party has the courage to go there, at least the courage test has been passed!
"Okay!" Gao Fei said loudly, "Don't worry, I guarantee you won't die in this first game."
With that said, Gao Fei changed the space and entered it.
Lu An looked at the spatial coordinates still in Hanyu and flew in without hesitation.
——————
——————
Hanyu.
One of the Black Star Rivers, the Moon Star River.
On a certain huge star, the space fluctuated, and two figures walked out one after another.
Gao Fei is in front, Lu An is behind.
As soon as he arrived here, Lu An looked in all directions.
Dark, depressing.
The entire city was filled with chilling and hostility.
Negative emotions enveloped the entire city and were very depressing.
Lu An looked at the sky. There were no clouds in the sky. The light from Hanyu was very weak, so the stars were so dim.
And, he could see a shining star.
Lu An immediately realized that the structure of this galaxy may be similar to that of the Immortal Galaxy, that is, it is divided into zonal stars and ring stars, and there may even be galaxies and star streams.
Not only that, Lu An also saw a special land in Hanyu.
That's right.
